source: claude-code subagent (viewed all 4 contact sheets + profile + transcript)
summary: A 27:45 'business trip' diary across Berlin, a grandmother's home in Poland, and Barcelona. A music-led montage (apartment, guest, gym) gives way to gym banter and a sit-down interview with a founder friend. Yellow cards ('10:30AM', 'NEXT DAY', 'BABCIU', 'BERLIN AIRPORT') segment the days. The emotional centre is a frank four-minute couch monologue about working 16-hour days, followed by a road trip to a friend's grandma. Barcelona brings metro, beach and lunch, and the film ends in a car promising the next episode.
hook_analysis: Visual lead-in with music (0:00-0:14: rounded-frame apartment, hallway, guest greeting), then a light spoken setup ('in Berlin with...') and gym banter. Most-replayed segment is the first ~17 s, so the montage itself is the hook; there is no stated stake.
narrative_arc: Berlin morning and gym (0:00-1:39) -> friend interview (1:49-4:08) -> 10:30AM retail store (4:18-4:28) -> evening car (4:38-5:07) -> NEXT DAY run (5:17-6:17) -> couch confession on pressure (6:46-10:44) -> drive to Poland (10:54-12:43) -> BABCIU dinner (12:53-14:12) -> hometown drive (14:22-16:41) -> packing and farewell (16:51-18:00) -> BERLIN AIRPORT (18:10) -> Barcelona plan, metro, beach, lunch (18:30-26:46) -> car ending as a cliff-hanger (27:05-27:35).
camera_and_composition: Two-shot interview framing in an industrial gym (1:49-4:08); locked-off medium on a couch (6:46-10:44); dashboard wide two-shots in cars (10:54-16:31); low wide selfies on the metro platform and beach (20:59-25:16). Rounded-corner inserts at 0:00, 1:39, 4:28, 12:53, 18:10. Cuts/moves not observable at storyboard resolution.
color_and_grade: Warm beige/tan palette (palette #bea484), moderate saturation, almost no low-key footage (5%). Barcelona daylight is bright and blue-skied; Berlin interiors warm tungsten.
sound_and_music: ~91% speech at ~157 wpm; music caption markers at the open and a ~14 s speech-free beat around 24:10-24:24. Captions include censored expletives.
what_to_borrow: Yellow day/time/place cards including personal names ('BABCIU') as chapter headings
A seated friend interview to add a second voice
Car dashboard two-shots for relaxed conversation during transit
End by setting up the next video
what_to_avoid_copying: Shirtless selfie coverage as the dominant Barcelona imagery
Ending on 'start a new video from here' without resolution if the film must stand alone
